top_violation_types.title: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited (26 TAC §746.1201(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: This standard was found deficient as part of a DFPS Investigation.

top_violation_types.title: Administering Medication - Original Container with Child's Name, Date (26 TAC §746.3805(b)(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Medication was not kept or stored in the original container for a child in care.

top_violation_types.title: Not Under the Influence of Alcohol or Controlled Substance (26 TAC §746.3703(c))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Based on information gathered it was determined there is reasonable evidence to believe a caregiver was under the influence of alcohol while caring for children.

top_violation_types.title: Adequate Lighting During Naptime (26 TAC §746.2911)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: In the 3 to 5 yr old classroom the room had inadequte light and the children were not visable. The caregiver could not see the children.

top_violation_types.title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operations classrooms are out of ratio at times.

top_violation_types.title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device - Remove the infant from the device and place the infant in a crib as soon as possible (26 TAC §746.2426(a)(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Based on the information obtained during the investigation, it was determined that a caregiver allowed an infant to fall asleep in a restrictive device (swing) for approximately twelve minutes before removing the infant from the device and placing the infant in a crib.

top_violation_types.title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two caregivers did not know how many children they were responsible for.

top_violation_types.title: Basic Requirements for Infants - Holding and Comforting (26 TAC §746.2401(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Based upon the information obtained, a caregiver did not comfort an infant who was visibly upset.
